I don't have the ability to browse the internet or access real-time news, so I can't pull up the latest NVIDIA headlines for you. My knowledge also has a cutoff date, so anything very recent would be outside what I know.

Here are some ways to get the latest NVIDIA news:

- **Official sources**: [NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/) or NVIDIA's blog
- **Financial news**: Bloomberg, Reuters, CNBC, or Yahoo Finance (ticker: NVDA)
- **Tech news**: The Verge, Ars Technica, Tom's Hardware, AnandTech
- **Aggregators**: Google News (search "NVIDIA"), or set up a Google Alert

If you'd like, I can share background information on topics like:
- NVIDIA's role in AI and GPUs
- Their key products (H100, B100/Blackwell, RTX series)
- Historical performance and major business developments

Just let me know what would be helpful!
